pilot_acceptance: Every launch/scoring/native correctness/fixture/identity/cleanup gate passes. Invalid run stops the series without a measurement retry.
Worst p95 across Open and all six actions improves by at least 10% against the new interleaved A series.
At least one of Open median or the maximum p95 across branch_first, branch_final, stack and comment_branch improves by at least 10%; an A1-only first-use drop does not establish a candidate gain.
Every final-20 action p95 and maximum, plus fresh-process Open median, p95 and maximum, remains at most 110% of the matching new A value. Preserve and investigate every failed guard.
Below-threshold improvement or noisy first-use evidence is inconclusive. No promotion from this pilot: all four cells and the exact delivered source/builds remain required.
acceptance.primary_metric: Worst end-to-end p95 across Open and all six actions. Report fresh-process Open separately and all first-use values; fresh-process does not mean OS-cold.
acceptance.target: Every cross-cell Open/action p95 below 250 ms. This one-cell pilot cannot complete the campaign.
